notes: Annual capital expenditure by company, USD. One record per company per year; 'year' is the fiscal year label (Microsoft FY ends Jun, Oracle FY ends May, Apple FY ends late Sep; others calendar year) and 'fiscal' states the exact period. kind='actual' = reported full-year figure; kind='guidance' = company outlook (capexUSD = midpoint of the range; range, date and revisions in the note), or a latest-known outlook for a year whose actual could not be verified. Definitions by company: Microsoft = 'capital expenditures including finance leases' (earnings-call figure) from FY2024 onward; FY2020-FY2023 use the cash 'additions to property and equipment' line because the incl.-finance-lease total was not verifiable for those years (DEFINITION BREAK between FY2023 and FY2024; finance-lease additions were roughly $3-4B/yr then, ~$11.6B in FY2024 and ~$20.5B in FY2025). Alphabet = 'purchases of property and equipment'. Amazon = 'purchases of property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales and incentives' (net cash capex; gross in note); excludes property acquired under finance leases. Meta = 'capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases' (Meta's own definition). Oracle = 'capital expenditures' (cash flow statement). Apple = 'payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment'. Tencent = reported capex, RMB converted at the period-average USD/CNY rate (stated in note). VERIFICATION STATUS: the shared web-search budget ran out partway through this task and WebFetch/SEC EDGAR access was blocked, so (a) Microsoft FY2026 and FY2027 data was verified by web search on 2026-11-20; (b) the other historical actuals are standard 10-K / earnings-release figures entered without re-fetching the filing this session (each note says so); (c) 2026 guidance for Alphabet, Amazon and Meta and FY2026 guidance for Oracle reflect the latest outlook that could be verified (given Dec-2025 to Feb-2026). Revisions on the Q1-Q3 2026 calls (Apr, Jul and Oct 2026), FY2026 actuals for Oracle, Apple and CoreWeave, and any 2027 outlook other than Microsoft's were NOT verified and need a follow-up pass. URLs point to the primary filing or IR page; where the exact release URL could not be confirmed, the URL is the company's SEC filing index or IR page. Not covered (no verifiable figures this session): xAI (private; reported figures not confirmed), Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent 2020-2022 and 2025-2026, and CoreWeave actuals. UPDATE (money agent, 2026-11-20): CoreWeave 2026 set to the $37-39B guidance from the Q3-2026 call (earnings coverage); Nebius 2026 guidance (~$27B) added. Alibaba's only firm figure is its Feb-2025 plan to spend 'more than RMB 380B' on cloud and AI infrastructure over three years (no annual record created).

Calendar-2026 guidance moved from ~$190B (Q3 FY26 call 2026-04-29, incl. ~$25B from higher component pricing) to ~$175B (Q4 FY26 call 2026-07-29, after data-center useful life went from 15 to 25 years, moving some leases from finance to operating, which capex excludes) to ~$170B (Q1 FY27 call 2026-10-28, delays in third-party capacity). SOURCE DISAGREEMENT: CNBC and others described the $170B as calendar 2027, but the quarterly figures ($31.9B + $41.0B + $45.2B + >$50B, which is about $170B) point to calendar 2026. From FY27, the lease reclassification lowers reported capex compared with earlier years. Verified by web search 2026-11-20.
